name: Redis
problems: license changed from permissive BSD-3-Clause (through 7.2.4) to source-available RSALv2/SSPLv1 (2024), then to a tri-license including OSI-approved AGPLv3 starting with Redis 8.0 (2025) - relevant for downstream packaging and cloud provider usage
the license change prompted a community fork (Valkey, Linux Foundation) that remains BSD-3-Clause licensed
source_notes: In-memory data structure store used as a database, cache, and message broker, originally created by Salvatore Sanfilippo. As of Redis 8.x, tri-licensed under RSALv2, SSPLv1, and AGPLv3.
